name: Doki Doki no Obama
source:
A visual novel/dating sim exploring the origins of Thomas Wheeler's position of FCC Chair... and a forbidden love.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140908091545/http://contest.rpgmakerweb.com/game/view/id/750#.U7rCoJRdVeG]2014 Indie Game Maker Contest[/url] page]
translation:
一款视觉小说／恋爱模拟游戏，探索托马斯·惠勒成为FCC主席的起源……以及一段禁忌之恋。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140908091545/http://contest.rpgmakerweb.com/game/view/id/750#.U7rCoJRdVeG]2014独立游戏制作大赛页面[/url]]
